text:
sec-scan-bot: automated intake: new vuln signal from dependency-scan: CVE-2026-3478 affecting libkms 2.1.3 -> deserialization RCE. EPSS: 0.42, CVSSv3: 8.6 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H). nvd: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-3478
sarah: saw it, thanks. any PoC or active exploit chatter?
dmitri: quick lookup -> there's a public gist with a minimal PoC but requires unauth endpoint. gist: https://gist.github.com/anon/abcdef
keiko: note: we use libkms only inside kms-proxy service (internal), not in hosted inference path. proxy handles signed token decryption for Dedicated customers.
jamal: sounds high-risk given RCE + no auth. propose PRIORITY: P1 (patch & rollback plan). assign @keiko to verify impact & @dmitri to draft mitigation playbook.
sarah: confirmed patch released upstream: libkms 2.1.5 fixes deserialization. PR to bump dependency should be small. anyone object to fast-tracking?
dmitri: no objection. mitigations in parallel: temporary WAF rule to block suspicious payload shape and add strict Content-Type checks. also enable extra audit logging on kms-proxy for the next 48h.
keiko: can run quick static test + integration tests in staging. ETA ~4h. will post results and workaround steps.
jamal: can infra do a hotpatch build for staging and then a canary to prod if tests pass? @sre-oncall can you standby for a quick deploy window?
sre-oncall: I can do a controlled canary. prefer to schedule a 30-min window. ping me when staging green.
dmitri: also verify RBAC: make sure service account used by kms-proxy has minimal privileges. add a temporary KMS key rotation audit entry and bump KMS request logging. I'll open an infra ticket.
keiko: test run 1: repro fails with current staging config (good) — looks like our deserializer is already using safe mode for untrusted payloads, but older deploys might be affected. I'll enumerate hosts with libkms 2.1.3. posting hosts list in 20m.
sarah: OK, owners: keiko -> impact verification + host sweep + patch PR; dmitri -> mitigation rules + audit logging + infra ticket; jamal -> coordinate canary / customer comms if needed.
sec-scan-bot: noted: creating vulnerability record id VULN-2026-3478-REDWOOD. auto-attach: scan report 2026-08-15T09:00Z.
jamal: if we need to notify customers, draft text should be minimal: "We patched an internal dependency with potential RCE; no evidence of customer data access; applying patch to Dedicated clusters now." keep legal in loop.
dmitri: quick scoring note: exploitability: public PoC (low complexity) + internet-exposed component -> exploitability = likely. EPSS 0.42 -> treat as high for internal services used by Dedicated.
keiko: hosts list posted. 3 old-stable hosts still on 2.1.3 in zone-3. I'll start deploying 2.1.5 hotpatch to those first.
sarah: thanks. please update this thread with PR link + staging green + canary start/finish times. closing once patch in prod and audit logs confirmed. :white_check_mark:
keiko: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/kms-proxy/pull/421 - bump libkms -> 2.1.5, unit + integration tests included. staging CI passing.
dmitri: mitigation rule applied to edge WAF (rule id 9923) and extra audit logging enabled. infra ticket INFRA-843 created for key rotation audit.
sre-oncall: canary kicked off at 2026-08-15T10:40Z, no errors in 20m window. proceeding to gradual rollout.
jamal: customer comm drafted, legal ok. planning to send only if we observe anomalies or customer impact.
sarah: final state: patch PR merged, prod rollout starting, owners validated. leaving thread open until prod audit logs show no suspicious activity for 48h.
keiko: will post final verification timestamp when done.
